_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. model sheet of a heavyset man in his late forties with gray in his beard and no hat, a green flannel and a black fleece vest, jeans and rubber boots, standing on a dock pointing at the water; front, profile, seated on a dock edge; labeled GULLY 2024. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, saturated color, neon, anime, busy composition, watermark, extra fingers
